name: discord
description: Discord messages from the servers and DMs your own client can see, forwarded live by a Vencord plugin, with selected club channels read for events and opportunities.

provides_capabilities.title: Discord
provides_capabilities.summary: Live messages from the servers and DMs your own Discord client can see.

setup.prompt: A long random token the plugin sends with each message, so only your client can post to Herald
The address the webhook listens on, port 8791: this machine's Tailscale or LAN IP, reachable from the computer running Discord
Channels to read for events and opportunities: channel id mapped to its guild id and flags
Words that keep a message away from any model, e.g. a course code whose material must stay private
A collector to run when new events are found, such as a calendar publisher

steps: Build Vencord with plugin/heraldForward as a user plugin and point Vesktop at it (README.md, Installing the plugin).
In the plugin's settings, set the URL to this machine's webhook address and the token to the one you stored.
herald ext enable discord, then herald services install and herald services enable.
